label: Whatever has its being caused by another is not INFINITE_1
paraphrase: Open bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed. Whatever has its being caused by some other being (CausesIn c x esse for some c other than x) is not INFINITE_1 (not unreceived subsistent being). After ST I q.7 a.2 and its ad 1 (it is against the nature of a made thing to be absolutely infinite): anything besides God has its being received into a distinct receiving potency, and so limited. Since 2026-11-12 it is derived (causedIsNotInfiniteFromReception, specs/dei-filius-unified-route.toml) from four existing open premises: whatever has its being caused by something distinct from it is a creature (STMT-CAUSED-IN-BEING-BY-ANOTHER-IS-CREATURE), the esse of every creature is received in some principle (STMT-CREATURE-ESSE-IS-RECEIVED), every received esse is limited (STMT-RECEIVED-ESSE-IS-LIMITED) and an INFINITE_1 being's esse is not limited (STMT-INFINITE-ESSE-IS-UNLIMITED). The step from caused being to received being is carried by the first two, through Creature. It does not over-generate against infinities secundum quid (q.7 a.2: relative infinity of created things), which are not INFINITE_1. SCOPE CONDITION, an explicit domain stipulation binding every premise that shares this Being and CausesIn (recorded in definition 80dea550): elements of Being are individuated by their act of being, so things numerically one in esse are one element. The divine persons share one numerically identical esse, so they are not distinct elements and cannot be represented as such; the Son's being from the Father is no instance of CausesIn c x esse with c distinct from x, and that esse is not received into a distinct receiving potency. Read without this stipulation, with the processions as instances, the bridge would conflict with the case's own Trinitarian commitment that the Son is infinite. (That q.33 a.1 ad 1 prefers 'principle' to 'cause' is only a terminological aside: the reply notes that the Greeks say 'cause'.) Control part 5: without it (both beings infinite), a being with the nine is comprehended by a caused intellect and is not INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2.
